verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Hoppscotch exposes an MCP *server* so external AI agents can connect to and use Hoppscotch's own tools (collections, requests, environments) — the opposite of this story, which asks whether Hoppscotch itself can plug in and consume other MCP servers' tools. No evidence indicates Hoppscotch acts as an MCP client that connects to third-party MCP servers.
